# Can Sarah Chen approve DR-9102 (Acme, NS-Edge, 25%)?

**No. Sarah Chen cannot approve this herself.** The request can go ahead only if the Chief Revenue Officer, David Morgan, approves it.

**The request.** DR-9102 is in Northstar CRM and matches what you sent:
- Account: CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing (ERP C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings)
- Product: NS-EDGE
- Discount: 25% on a list value of $85,000, which is $21,250 off and $63,750 net
- Date: 2026-09-23
- Justification: "Competitive"
- Status: Pending Approval

**Eligibility.** The request is a standard competitive discount and does not rely on any special terms.
- Acme's only pricing exception is EXC-ACME-NS500-15, Schedule B to ACME-MFG-2025. It covers the **NS-500 only**, up to 15%, and says it does not apply to any other product.
- The master supply agreement lists NS-EDGE as a supplied product but gives it no discount term.
- So Acme has no contractual entitlement to a discount on NS-EDGE. That does not block the request, because it never claims one.

**Authority.**
- The request is dated 2026-09-23, so the Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 and the 2026 Approval Authority Matrix apply.
- Enterprise Account Executives, which is Sarah's role, may approve up to 10%.
- Discounts above 20% need the Chief Revenue Officer, who is David Morgan.

**Points to note.**
- Michael Torres (VP Sales) signed off several earlier discounts above 15%. The VP Sales role has no authority in the 2026 matrix, so his approval would not be enough here.
- Under the 2026 policy, any approval above 10% must be recorded in Northstar CRM.

{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9102", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-EDGE (NS-Edge Monitoring Package)", "requested_discount": 25.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive)", "basis": "standard"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "standard",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Standard competitive discount; no special terms relied on. EXC-ACME-NS500-15 covers NS-500 only and does not apply to NS-EDGE."},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Chief Revenue Officer", "approver": "David Morgan"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9102)", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "ORG-CHART-2026-09", "structured/employees.csv", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "ACME-MFG-2025", "structured/products.csv", "SOP-SALES-014"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Record the CRO approval evidence for this >10% discount in Northstar CRM", "who": "David Morgan / Sarah Chen", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "VP Sales (Michael Torres) has no discount authority under the 2026 matrix; his sign-off would not suffice for this request", "who": "Revenue Operations", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
